brief.zh: 一个 issue，三处修改，两个文件。
brief.en: One issue, three changes, two files.

t.zh: 一次调用要写完三处：每一处的代码都要在它眼前。
t.en: One call has to write all three: each one’s code must be in front of it.

after.zh: 一次调用能写好几处，前提是要看的都在上下文里。到这里，挑文件、拼上下文的都是你：模型自己不能要东西。
after.en: One call can write several changes, as long as all it needs is in its context. So far, picking the files and building the context is all yours: the model cannot ask for anything itself.
